Section II — Terms, Conditions & Certifications

The following terms apply to any resulting award. Vendors shall review and confirm compliance in their
response.

1. Indemnification: The Contractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Department of
Veterans Affairs, its officers and employees, from any claims, damages, or liabilities, including
reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from the Contractor's performance under this solicitation.
2. Payment Terms: Invoices shall be paid Net 45 days in accordance with the Prompt Payment Act.
3. Firm Pricing: Unit prices shall remain firm for the twelve (12) month base period; no price escalation
will be accepted during the base period.
4. Delivery Terms: All items shall be delivered F.O.B. Destination to the VA Medical Center receiving
dock; freight and handling shall be included in the unit price.
5. Insurance: The Contractor shall carry Commercial General Liability insurance of at least $1,000,000
per occurrence and provide a Certificate of Insurance naming the Government as additional insured

prior to award.
6. E-Verify Certification: The Contractor certifies participation in the E-Verify program for verification of
employment eligibility of all employees performing under this contract.
7. Debarment: The Contractor certifies that it and its principals are not presently debarred, suspended,
or proposed for debarment from participation in federal procurement.
8. Stark Law / Anti-Kickback: The Contractor warrants that no arrangement under this contract violates
the federal physician self-referral (Stark) law or the Anti-Kickback Statute.
9. Most Favored Customer: The Contractor certifies that pricing offered is no less favorable than that
offered to any commercial customer for comparable quantities.
10. Anti-Lobbying Certification: Pursuant to 31 U.S.C. 1352, the Contractor certifies that no
appropriated funds have been paid to influence a federal officer in connection with this award.
11. Intellectual Property Infringement: The Contractor warrants that the goods furnished do not infringe
any patent or trademark and shall defend the Government against any infringement claim.
12. Affirmative Action / EEO: The Contractor shall maintain a written affirmative action plan and comply
with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity requirements.
13. Political Contributions: The Contractor shall disclose reportable political contributions in accordance
with applicable pay-to-play requirements.
14. Tax Exemption: The Department of Veterans Affairs is exempt from federal excise and state sales
tax; such taxes shall not be included in the Contractor's pricing.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the Department of Veterans Affairs, its officers and employees, from any claims, damages, or liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from the Contractor's performance under this solicitation.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Uncapped indemnity obligations are a material liability exposure requiring counsel review.

bid_requirements.raw_text: Invoices shall be paid Net 45 days in accordance with the Prompt Payment Act.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Payment terms affect working capital and DSO.

bid_requirements.raw_text: Unit prices shall remain firm for the twelve (12) month base period; no price escalation will be accepted during the base period.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Firm-pricing periods transfer cost-inflation risk to the vendor for the locked term.

bid_requirements.raw_text: All items shall be delivered F.O.B. Destination to the VA Medical Center receiving dock; freight and handling shall be included in the unit price.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: FOB Destination shifts freight cost and in-transit risk to the vendor vs. FOB Shipper's Dock.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor shall carry Commercial General Liability insurance of at least $1,000,000 per occurrence and provide a Certificate of Insurance naming the Government as additional insured prior to award.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Minimum insurance / coverage requirements are owned by Risk Management.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor certifies participation in the E-Verify program for verification of employment eligibility of all employees performing under this contract.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: E-Verify participation is an employment-eligibility program owned by HR.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor certifies that it and its principals are not presently debarred, suspended, or proposed for debarment from participation in federal procurement.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Debarment certifications carry federal contracting eligibility and False Claims Act exposure.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor warrants that no arrangement under this contract violates the federal physician self-referral (Stark) law or the Anti-Kickback Statute.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Stark Law / anti-kickback provisions are high-risk healthcare-regulatory exposure.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor certifies that pricing offered is no less favorable than that offered to any commercial customer for comparable quantities.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: MFN / best-price clauses bind pricing across the whole book of business — major commercial risk.

bid_requirements.raw_text: Pursuant to 31 U.S.C. 1352, the Contractor certifies that no appropriated funds have been paid to influence a federal officer in connection with this award.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Anti-lobbying certifications (e.g. Byrd Amendment) require a formal legal attestation.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor warrants that the goods furnished do not infringe any patent or trademark and shall defend the Government against any infringement claim.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: IP infringement warranties can create open-ended defense obligations.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor shall maintain a written affirmative action plan and comply with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity requirements.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Affirmative-action / EEO plans are HR-owned compliance obligations.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor shall disclose reportable political contributions in accordance with applicable pay-to-play requirements.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Political-contribution disclosures ('pay-to-play') are owned by Corporate Affairs.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Department of Veterans Affairs is exempt from federal excise and state sales tax; such taxes shall not be included in the Contractor's pricing.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Tax-exemption and withholding provisions are owned by Tax.

The following terms apply to any resulting award. Vendors shall review and confirm compliance in their
response.

1. Marketing Fees: Any marketing, promotional, or advertising allowance associated with this contract
shall be disclosed and shall comply with applicable fair-market-value requirements.

2. Price Reduction: If the Contractor reduces its prices to any comparable customer during the contract
term, the same reduction shall be extended to the Agency retroactively to the effective date.

3. Anti-Lobbying Certification: Pursuant to 31 U.S.C. 1352, the Contractor certifies that no federally
appropriated funds have been paid or will be paid to influence any federal officer in connection with the
award of this contract.

4. Administrative Fee: The Contractor agrees to remit a quarterly administrative fee equal to one
percent (1%) of net sales under any resulting contract.

5. Litigation Disclosure: The Contractor shall disclose any pending or threatened litigation,
administrative proceeding, or investigation that could materially affect its ability to perform.
6. Most Favored Customer: The Contractor warrants that the prices offered herein are no less favorable
than those extended to any other customer purchasing like quantities under similar conditions.
7. Non-Collusion / Anti-Trust: The Contractor certifies that its bid was arrived at independently and
without collusion, and that it has not violated any federal or state anti-trust laws.
8. Tax Exemption: The Agency is exempt from federal excise and state sales tax; the Contractor shall
not include such taxes in its pricing and shall accept the Agency's tax-exemption certificate.
9. Intellectual Property Infringement: The Contractor warrants that the goods furnished do not infringe
any patent, copyright, or trademark, and shall defend and indemnify the Government against any claim
of infringement arising from their use.
10. Warranty of Products: The Contractor warrants that all products furnished are new, of merchantable
quality, and free from defects in material and workmanship for the manufacturer's warranty period.
11. Firm Pricing: All unit prices shall remain firm and fixed for the twelve (12) month base period of the
contract and shall not be subject to escalation.

bid_requirements.raw_text: Any marketing, promotional, or advertising allowance associated with this contract shall be disclosed and shall comply with applicable fair-market-value requirements.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Marketing-fee arrangements require compliance review under fair-market-value rules.

bid_requirements.raw_text: If the Contractor reduces its prices to any comparable customer during the contract term, the same reduction shall be extended to the Agency retroactively to the effective date.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Price-reduction clauses can ratchet pricing down over the contract term.

bid_requirements.raw_text: Pursuant to 31 U.S.C. 1352, the Contractor certifies that no federally appropriated funds have been paid or will be paid to influence any federal officer in connection with the award of this contract.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Anti-lobbying certifications (e.g. Byrd Amendment) require a formal legal attestation.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor agrees to remit a quarterly administrative fee equal to one percent (1%) of net sales under any resulting contract.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Administrative-fee commitments reduce net realized margin.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor shall disclose any pending or threatened litigation, administrative proceeding, or investigation that could materially affect its ability to perform.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Disclosure of pending litigation must be verified by counsel before certifying.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor warrants that the prices offered herein are no less favorable than those extended to any other customer purchasing like quantities under similar conditions.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: MFN / best-price clauses bind pricing across the whole book of business — major commercial risk.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor certifies that its bid was arrived at independently and without collusion, and that it has not violated any federal or state anti-trust laws.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Anti-trust / non-collusion certifications carry criminal and civil exposure.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Agency is exempt from federal excise and state sales tax; the Contractor shall not include such taxes in its pricing and shall accept the Agency's tax-exemption certificate.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Tax-exemption and withholding provisions are owned by Tax.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor warrants that the goods furnished do not infringe any patent, copyright, or trademark, and shall defend and indemnify the Government against any claim of infringement arising from their use.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: IP infringement warranties can create open-ended defense obligations.

bid_requirements.raw_text: The Contractor warrants that all products furnished are new, of merchantable quality, and free from defects in material and workmanship for the manufacturer's warranty period.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Product warranty scope drives replacement/return obligations and legal warranty exposure.

bid_requirements.raw_text: All unit prices shall remain firm and fixed for the twelve (12) month base period of the contract and shall not be subject to escalation.
bid_requirements.risk_rationale: Firm-pricing periods transfer cost-inflation risk to the vendor for the locked term.

Section II — Terms, Conditions & Certifications

The following terms apply to any resulting award. Vendors shall review and confirm
compliance in their response.

1. Administrative Fee: As a group purchasing organization contract, the Contractor shall
remit a quarterly administrative fee of two percent (2%) of net purchases by member
facilities.

2. Rebate Commitments: Any tiered volume rebates shall be described, including thresholds
and the rebate percentage at each tier.

3. Firm Pricing: Contract pricing shall remain firm for the initial twelve-month renewal
term.

4. Price Reduction: The Contractor shall extend to members any price decrease offered to
comparable customers during the contract term.

5. Most Favored Nation: The Contractor warrants that member pricing represents its best
price for like quantities and comparable terms.

6. Marketing Fees: Any promotional or marketing allowance associated with this agreement
shall be disclosed and comply with fair-market-value requirements.

7. Royalty Fees: Any royalty or licensing fee embedded in offered pricing shall be separately
disclosed for compliance review.

8. Warranty of Products: All products shall be warranted free from defects for the
manufacturer's stated warranty period.
